g.text: Radar and Wi-Fi both need a polyethylene aperture: cast aluminium is a boundary condition, not a lossy dielectric.

g.desc: Radar and Wi-Fi both need a polyethylene aperture: cast aluminium is a boundary condition, not a lossy dielectric.

g.text: TVS1's standoff/breakdown/clamp are all UNREAD — an SMBJ28A here would sit in conduction at 29.2 V absorb. Transcribe before fitting.

g.desc: TVS1's standoff/breakdown/clamp are all UNREAD — an SMBJ28A here would sit in conduction at 29.2 V absorb. Transcribe before fitting.

g.text: U2 exists because the pixels want a 3.5 V VIH and the ESP32 gives 3.3 V. A naked GPIO data line is the control that fails prove_data_meets_pixel_vih.

g.desc: U2 exists because the pixels want a 3.5 V VIH and the ESP32 gives 3.3 V. A naked GPIO data line is the control that fails prove_data_meets_pixel_vih.

g.text: Base load [I]: ESP32 ~1.2 W + LD2410 ~0.4 W, 1.88 W at the bus after 85% conversion.

g.desc: Base load [I]: ESP32 ~1.2 W + LD2410 ~0.4 W, 1.88 W at the bus after 85% conversion.
